summary:
Implementation plan for the Account Creation Form and Birthdate Visibility enhancements:
1. Make Middle Name and Suffix strictly optional with explicit '(Optional)' field hints in both SignInPage and AuthModal.
2. Enforce complete form filling so registration cannot proceed if any required field is missing.
3. Apply real-time input sanitization on First Name and Last Name to strictly allow alphabetical letters and spaces while blocking numbers and special characters on keystroke.
4. Integrate birthdate display across the Resident Profile banner, Staff Desk verification review queue, and Punong Barangay Executive Signing Portal.
